input.prompt: Create a precise 4 by 4 animation sprite sheet for a cozy matcha cafe game. Exactly sixteen equal cells, ordered left to right then top to bottom, one continuous action. Same warm hand-painted anime storybook style as the reference, clean brown outlines, soft morning light. Flat uniform cream background in every cell. Identical camera, scale, and crop. Show only the objects named below. No hands, no fingers, no arms, no sleeves, no person, no face. No extra tools, bottles, bowls, flowers, petals, trays, kettles, or counter clutter beyond the named objects. No cell borders, text, numbers, labels, or UI. Only a metal sieve, green matcha powder, and one empty cream chawan. Powder enters the sieve and falls into a smooth mound. The sieve moves by itself. No hands, no other tools.
